title: Mara Cardenas
body: Transfer authorization reads 'program and emergency cargo, one lane' with the destination left blank. Reverse: bread for Mother.
rival_reading: The same shared-lane authorization could carry an agricultural program's cargo under routine transfer rules; a blank destination does not show anyone was stranded by a checkpoint order.
gloss: A courier's transfer authorization covers 'program and emergency cargo' with no destination entered.

title: The route ended beyond the gate
body: The map's transfer mark sits past a road closed for reasons unstated. The key ring's last tag is unlogged, and a field-service pass rides loose in the console.
rival_reading: A field-service pass and an unlogged key could just as easily belong to an ordinary agricultural courier route; a closed road by itself does not establish a failed evacuation.
gloss: A courier's transfer mark sits past a closed road beside an unlogged key and a loose field pass.
